title: Rollback VAT priority logic changes in VAT + invoice flow (frontend-only) and update production marker

requirements.summary: Rollback VAT calculator + invoice UI outputs to pre–VAT-priority behavior by reverting the invoice VAT outcome derivation and any UI labels introduced by the new priority rules.
acceptanceCriteria: Running the VAT calculator + invoice flow produces the same VAT rate/label/amount outcomes as the previous version (i.e., before the last VAT priority-logic changes).
No newly introduced VAT-priority-specific labels or outcomes (e.g., any newly added precedence behavior) appear if they did not exist in the prior version.
The app builds successfully without TypeScript errors (frontend) and Motoko compilation errors (backend).

file_operations.description: Revert the new strict VAT-priority decision logic to the prior invoice VAT outcome behavior (rates/labels/amounts), removing any newly introduced precedence rules and labels (e.g., export-precedence/"Zero Rated Export" if it was not present previously).
Align invoice save/download VAT rate/label/currency derivation with the rolled-back VAT outcome logic so persisted invoice metadata and on-screen totals reflect the pre-change behavior.

Update VAT results UI rendering to remove/avoid any newly introduced VAT-priority-specific labels/outcomes and ensure displayed VAT information matches the rolled-back calculation/invoice flow behavior.

Verify the VAT-to-invoice navigation and step state remains consistent after the rollback (no references to the reverted VAT-priority behavior), ensuring the flow outputs match the pre-change version.

requirements.summary: Update the production console marker to clearly indicate the rolled-back build version and keep the publish checklist consistent with the marker output.
acceptanceCriteria: In production mode, the browser console marker reflects the rolled-back release identifier (e.g., the previous marker/version), allowing easy verification that rollback is deployed.
The production publish checklist remains consistent with the production marker output used for verification.

file_operations.description: Change the production marker version identifier to the rolled-back release value (e.g., from v5 back to the prior version) so operators can verify rollback via the browser console.
Wire the existing production marker mechanism to run on initial app load from within the layout (import and call the marker logger once) so the console marker reliably appears after deployment.
Update the checklist text to match the rolled-back production marker string/version so the documented verification step remains consistent with the console output.
